figures.notes: Panel A clearly displays the empirical Cerro Paranal R=86,000 zenith K-band telluric transmission profile across 1.95-2.48 um with shaded K-short, 2040 nm Tm-fiber, core K_s (2097 nm Ho:YAG), and K-long windows plus non-overlapping white-boxed laser callouts; Panel B shows 9-band synthetic recovery completeness across 1,620 Channel T + Channel P trials (83.33% at 2040.0 nm Tm-fiber and 94.44% at 2097.0 nm Ho:YAG for >=8 sigma single-epoch, 88.89% >=12 sigma persistent); Panel C displays 98.6% (71/72) true slit-laser pass rate and 100.0% (72/72 + 72/72) Hawaii-2RG IPC hot-pixel and persistence-plateau rejection.

Panel A illustrates the 135 paired moving-planet CW track trials on GJ 588 (Delta v_orb = 224.4 km/s), boosting >=6.5 sigma_exp orbital-stack recovery from 0.0% (uncompensated Channel T_DIFF, alpha=0) to 53.1% (Keplerian de-Doppler Channel K_PLANET, alpha=1); Panel B plots all 66 exposures across the 7 CRIRES+ orbital campaigns in signed orbital phase vs planetary RV; Panel C charts the logarithmic four-generation cascade across 148 exposures from 1,043 Legacy V2 false alarms (188 control + 855 science) down to 0 orbital-stack candidates and 17 Channel T/P survivors (all 17 forensically verified as nocturnal OH Meinel / H2RG warm pixels, beta Pic circumstellar Br-gamma wing, or PDS 70 continuum shoulder; 0 ETI detections).

Panel A shows all 162 Cohen et al. (2003) 2MASS K_s calibrated 8-sigma 10 m beamed CW laser upper-limit cells across the 18 D083 science hosts ordered by distance (reaching 1,513.2 W overall, 1,557.7 W at 2097.0 nm Ho:YAG, and 2,380.1 W at 2040.0 nm Tm-fiber on LHS 3844, plus 2.92 kW on Ross 128 at 3.375 pc); Panel B maps the complete 71-cell 0.38-2.48 um four-star panchromatic bridge across Proxima Centauri (ESPRESSO + NIRPS), Barnard's Star (ESPRESSO + NIRPS), GJ 229 A (HARPS + CRIRES+ K), and AU Mic (NIRPS + CRIRES+ K) with zero legend overlap.

Panel A maps best 8-sigma 10 m laser power limits vs distance across all 100 unique stellar systems (649 exposures across HARPS, ESPRESSO, NIRPS_HE, and CRIRES+ K) with 18 zero-planet controls; Panel B zooms into the 35-star d < 10 pc solar-neighborhood census with collision-free callouts for Proxima Centauri, Barnard's Star, Ross 128, GJ 3323, GJ 229 A, and AU Mic; Panel C combines the 120-system multi-messenger synthesis (100 echelle + 23 Parkes/GBT 1.4 GHz radio + 1 TESS specular light-sail, 4 direct overlap stars, 0 verified ETI detections) with the exact M35 95% held-out transmitter-fraction curve.
